label: 📮 Boundary by US ZIP
description: Look up the WKB boundary of a US ZIP Code Tabulation Area (ZCTA) from a 5-digit ZIP or a lat/lon point. The bundled boundary is APPROXIMATE — derived from the Census Bureau gazetteer's centroid + land area as an equal-area circle. For a marker-style map this is accurate; for a high-fidelity choropleth, use a custom ZCTA polygon dataset and a join step.

input_mode.label: Input mode
enumLabels: auto · try text first, fall back to point

input_column.label: ZIP column
input_column.help: Column with 5-digit US ZIP codes. Leading zeros must be preserved (e.g. "00501" for Holtsville, NY). The lookup also tolerates "02139-1234" — the trailing +4 is stripped.
